title: [CUDA] Synchronize expandable segment unmaps on their owning device
body:
Fixes #196258.

Thanks @sxtyzhangzk for reporting this issue and identifying the synchronization problem.

CUDA stream 0 is represented by a null handle. The same value is used for every device, so `cudaStreamSynchronize(nullptr)` selects stream 0 from the caller's current device. 

Because `empty_cache()` can release segments owned by another device, it could synchronize the wrong stream and unmap memory while work was still using it.
